correctness.rationale: The norm-one quaternion pair UxU covers split SO4 by a finite etale separable central isogeny of degree 2 when characteristic !=2. Exactly the four diagonal entries of the left-right action form an invertible Hadamard transformation of a_h b_h, so the pullback of the whole hollow ideal is a_hb_h=0 for h=0..3. Supports A,B are disjoint nonempty, and two norm equations solve units by implicit functions; r=4-|A|-|B|=0,1,2 zero-support pairs yield formal rings k[[s,t]], k[[t,x,y]]/(xy), k[[x,y,z,w]]/(xy,zw). Fitting2 Jacobian singular ideal at r2 is the six squarefree pair products, radical union of four coordinate axes; at r1 it is (x,y) so reduced. Count 24 r1 support patterns/curves and 12 r2 support pairs times 2 quotient sign orbits=24 four-branch points (three double transpositions times eight determinant-one signs). Fresh independent quaternion Hadamard and combinatorial support count/jacobian check; unbounded-field statement from formal local derivation.
